_about: Central Tracks hymns: public-domain words and tunes (published before 1929, and every writer dead more than 70 years, so they're free to use in the US and abroad), in our own arrangements. 10.2: played as a modern worship band would (tools/worship_band.py): each section has a role (intro, verse, verse2, pre, chorus, interlude, drop, bridge, final, tag, outro) and "style" picks the band's flavour. Format: chords = one entry per bar ("G", or several chords with the beat they start on: "G D@4"); a section's progression is a name or "name:from-to" (bars, 1-based); lyrics = the pickup, then one entry per bar, split by |; ~ joins a word across bars, / ends a lyric line, ^ marks where a bar's next chord falls. A section's chords may repeat ("intro*2") and its lyrics may be part of a verse ("Verse 5@9-16": its bars 9 to 16).
